text.p: A Reuters survey of analysts covering Finnish equities showed a 647 million markka median forecast for paper machine maker Valmet Oy's January-August profit after financial items, before extraordinaries.
The results are due on October 1 at 1100/0800 GMT.

In January-August 1995, Valmet posted a 328 million markka profit. It changed at the start of 1996 its accounting methods to a so-called percentage of completion system, and will report eight-month 1996 figures according to both the old and the new methods, a Valmet spokeswoman said.

For Valmet's full-year 1996 profit, 10 of the 14 analysts polled gave a median forecast of 926 million markka (mean 955 million) in an 836-1,270 million markka range. The 1995 profit was 637 million markka.
The data were collected in the fourth week of September.

Contributors to the survey were AG Private Bankers, Aktia Bank, Aros Securities, Carnegie, Enskilda, Erik Selin, Evli Securities, FIM Securities, FSB, Handelsbanken, Interbank, Merita Securities, Opstock and Postipankki.
